type.title: Campaign type
type.standardDesc: One email to the audience you choose, sent now or at a scheduled time.
type.standardDescWhatsApp: A WhatsApp message to the audience you choose, sent now or at a scheduled time.
type.automatedDesc: A sequence triggered by what a client does, such as booking or going quiet.
type.autoresponderDesc: Sent automatically to each new subscriber the moment they sign up.
type.autoresponderDescWhatsApp: Sent on its own to each contact as soon as they agree to receive news on WhatsApp.
type.splitDesc: Two subjects or two versions; the better one goes to the rest of the list.
type.dateBasedDesc: Sent around a date on the contact, such as a birthday or an anniversary.
type.rssDesc: Goes out whenever the blog publishes something new.
type.channelLocked: The channel cannot be changed on a campaign that is already saved. Create a new campaign to use the other one.
type.appointmentDesc: A WhatsApp message before or after each appointment: reminder or follow-up. Only to clients who accepted appointment notices.
type.kindLocked: A saved campaign cannot become an Appointment notice or stop being one: it counts appointments, not lists.
type.consentNoteWhatsApp: WhatsApp only writes to people who agreed to receive news and offers, using a template approved by Meta. The Appointment notice is the exception: it goes to clients who switched on appointment notices.
type.consentNoteEmail: An email only goes to people subscribed to the newsletter (who agreed to receive news and offers), with a valid address, no unsubscribe and no bounce. No condition and no hand-made list gets round this rule.

help.name: Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores (_) only. Meta does not let you change it after submitting.

help.header: Text only, up to 60 characters. It cannot contain '{{'n'}}' variable values.
help.body: Up to 1024 characters. Write '{{'1'}}', '{{'2'}}'… where the data should change on each send. They cannot be at the very start or end.
help.footer: Up to 60 characters. It cannot contain '{{'n'}}' variable values.
help.buttons: Up to 3. A link must start with https:// and is fixed: it cannot contain '{{'n'}}' variable values.
help.examples: Meta will not review a template without an example for each variable value. Write a realistic value.
help.optOutButton: For a button to unsubscribe the client, its text must be exactly STOP (or BAJA in Spanish).

rules.consent: Only clients who ticked “appointment notices” and have not written STOP receive the message. Numbers Meta could not deliver to are left out, and so are numbers that wrote STOP even if another contact file has them ticked: the STOP list is by number.
rules.nothing: If there is no template set up for the booking's language, nothing is sent.
rules.languages: Each language needs its own template. Every booking is sent in the language it was made in or, when that is not known, in the one on the contact's file, and a contact with no language chosen is on file as English: it is worth setting up English too.
rules.stop: Include in the template's text a phrase such as “Reply STOP to stop receiving these notices”.
rules.noButtons: Templates with a variable-link button are not offered: this send does not fill buttons.
